chase: Excuse me. I would like a word with you, please.
Pardon me, but you are standing on my route tonight.
I will be right behind you. Please keep moving forward.
Let us take this slowly. Slowly is kinder for both of us.
Places, everyone. You are the one I am looking for.
Ten steps behind you, and I am keeping careful count.
I counted your steps. You are four doors from me.
Keep going, please. I am only a few steps back.
The corridor is long, but I know exactly where you turned.
Slow down, please. Running makes the whole scene messy.
I can see the hem of your coat at the end of the corridor.
Round the next corner and I will be waiting, politely.
You have nowhere to go on this mark, I am afraid.
Stay where you are, please. This will only take a moment.
Closing the distance now. Thank you for your patience.
Right, then left. Follow the hall and do not hurry.
Pardon me, I'm following you at a respectful distance.
Please don't make me chase you through the foyer.
The scene is changing. Keep to the left, please.
catch: Caught you, I think. Would you mind coming along quietly?
I am taking you out of the scene now. Nothing personal.
Oh dear, you have been found. Please gather your things.
Got you. Please come along to the lounge with me.
Your part in this scene has ended. Please come with me.
I have you by the sleeve. Do not pull away, please.
Taken out of the frame. The rest of the cast will carry on.
I am sorry about the drag. It is the shortest route out.
One of them has been caught. I am sorry, they were close.
You put up a fight, which I respect. Come along now.
Your run ends here, at the foot of the stairs.
That is the end of your scene. Thank you for playing.
Nothing personal. The house needs its quiet back tonight.
Gently now. I have you, and you are not going anywhere.
Please do not struggle. The scene will be tidier that way.
Another one taken off the stage. The next scene is starting.
Caught. Please don't make this any more awkward.
Forgive me, but you have to come with me now.
Thank you for stopping. I'll be quick about this.
hear: Someone is by the stairs. Would one of you check, please?
Did that door just open? I will go and look.
Something broke in the back rooms. I am going to see.
That shout came from the lounge. Stay quiet, and I will check.
Please keep the noise down. Sound carries very well in this hall.
A door banged somewhere behind the returns shelf. Investigating now.
Glass went over on the second floor. I will take a look.
Somebody is not where the cue sheet says. I will go and check.
I heard a rattle near the vents. Let me see who it is.
A shout, then silence. Silence is worse, I think.
The side door is rattling again. Would someone close it, please?
I can hear two of you on the stairs. Please spread out.
Something dropped in the lounge. Tell me it was not the lamp.
A squeak on the floorboards, right by the locker. I am coming.
Footsteps on the upper floor, and they are not mine.
Someone called out, very near the east door. I am going now.
A door clicked in the east wing. Excuse me, I'll check.
Something fell in the corridor. Shall I investigate?
Footsteps in the stairwell. Quiet, please, I'm listening.
search: You lost me just now. That was very nicely done.
Oh, you slipped past me. Well done. Try it again later.
Where did you go? I will look behind the shelves.
I have lost the trail near the stairwell. Searching now.
Nobody is in the lounge. Let me check the back rooms.
I will search the corridor slowly, and check every door.
Hmm, I seem to have lost my place in the script.
Gone quiet again. Back to the route, then.
Perhaps you went up. I will check the stairs twice.
Hush. I am listening for your footsteps now.
You cannot have gone far. I will look in every room.
You are not where I expected. Let me look again.
I will count the doors again. One of them must be open.
That is enough searching for now. Back to patrol.
Sniffing the air for you. Nothing yet, I am afraid.
Each room, one at a time. I am very patient, you know.
stunned: Ow. That was a very unfriendly way to end my route.
Oh my. I did not expect the taser to be quite so loud.
Give me a moment. My hands are still humming.
Please wait while I recover my footing.
The crowbar was unnecessary, but I will forgive it.
That axe was heavier than it looked, I must say.
Stunned again, and very cross about it.
Give me a second, and I will be right with you.
My joints are a little stiff, that is all. Shaking it off now.
That hit was rude. I will remember it.
Hold still, my hands are not quite listening to me yet.
You have a strong arm. I will remember that.
The shock has run all the way through my frame.
Recovering now. Please do not take that as a compliment.
My head is still ringing. One more moment, please.
A taser on the stairs? That was very well placed.
hide_spot: Lovely hiding spot. That locker door squeaked, though, I am afraid.
Hiding there is a fine choice. I will simply wait nearby.
Please stay quiet in there. The corridor carries every sound.
Your breathing gives you away, I am afraid. Gently now.
Shall we continue? You have a very good hiding spot, though.
I can see the edge of your coat under that bed.
Beds are the first place I check. My apologies.
Behind the curtain again. It is always the curtain.
I am opening the locker very slowly. Please hold still.
Your shoes are poking out from under the desk.
Is that a locker, or a very confident coat rack?
I will walk past this one. Pretend you are not here.
Under the table is a bold choice, I must say.
I can hear you breathing behind the cabinet. Lovely.
Nobody hides behind the returns shelf, except you, it seems.
Charming spot. Your feet are not quite hidden, though.
light: A flashlight on me. Lovely. I will step aside for now.
Your light is on me. I will step out of the frame, politely.
You turned the flashlight away. How considerate. I will return.
Hold the flashlight steady, please. Shaking ruins the shot.
You are standing in the open. That is not the plan.
Please lower the flashlight. You are blinding the stage.
That lamp is very bright. I need a moment to see.
Ah, the beam is in my eyes again. Please, a little to the left.
Flashlight in my face. Very rude, and very effective.
I am dazzled. Give me a moment to look at the floor.
Lamp on, and I cannot make out the floor. Please dim it.
Light on my face is not a kindness, I am afraid.
Oh, a spotlight. How very theatrical of you.
Your beam is steady, I will give you that.
Stand still, please. This glare is hard on my sight.
Every lamp in this hall is pointed at me today.
idle: I am dusting the returns shelf. Everything goes back on time.
A book is due by morning. I will bring it back myself.
Everything returned on time keeps the house in good order.
Please leave the returns shelf as you found it. Thank you.
A clean shelf is a calm shelf. I do like calm things.
Dust, sort, return. Then I can sit quietly for a while.
I do not mind the quiet. It is the best time to tidy.
Each returned item goes back in its proper place, neatly and early.
I like the returns shelf best in the early hours.
Someone left a card on the returns shelf. I will file it.
The others are in the lounge. I am the quiet one here.
Has anyone moved the returns shelf again? It was tidy this morning.
Stage lights off, and I can finally sit down.
Nobody notices me in the corner, which suits me fine.
I keep the schedule in my head, and nobody asks.
Tea is cooling in the lounge. I will not touch it.
ability: Open the full map if you want to find me. I am on it.
Keep one eye on the map. I am marked there, quite clearly.
On the map I am a small dot, moving at a sensible pace.
Map open, trace on. You will know exactly where I went.
Out of sight on the floor is not out of sight on the map.
The map shows my trace even when the floor is dark.
Watch the map as well as the corners. I leave a trace there.
You can see me on the map, though not always on the floor.
My route is on the map, so you may plan around it.
You do not need to see me to know where I am.
Watch the dot, not the dark. The dot is me.
The map is kind enough to show you my whole route.
I am easy to forget on the floor, but the map never forgets.
Map on, and you will see my dot wander the halls.
Your map still shows me, even when I have stepped aside.
mechanic: Facility radar on means I am traced. Check the map now.
Radar down, and my trace goes quiet. Very convenient for me.
If the radar fails, the map goes dark and so do I.
Nobody is watching the east door. Could someone take it, please?
Please do not prop the vent door open. It rattles everything.
The battery packs are on the top shelf, if anyone needs one.
Mind the step at the foot of the stairs. Someone always trips.
Please leave the relay panels alone. They are very touchy.
The east vents are open. I am using the stairs, thank you.
A fall on the stairs costs you time. Mind the landing.
Items on the returns shelf must go back before the next cue.
Somebody pulled a relay cable. I will put it back.
Sabotage is not in the spirit of the house. Please stop it.
Wait for the door to close before you cross the hall.
Radar blips near the lounge. That will be the others.
A relay change sends everyone a different way. Pay attention.
Radar is tracking the battery. Keep it charged.
Facility relay is down. Trace will fade soon.
The vent connects to the old wing. Check the map.
